emails.text: I request access to all personal data, communications records, decision logs, and internal notes concerning my account.
We provide the account summary and consider this disclosure complete. No further information is necessary.
The disclosure is incomplete because communications, decision logs, and underlying records are missing.
Internal decision records and review logs are retained in the file but will not be disclosed to the customer.
The bank controls the complete file and will select which records are relevant for disclosure.
Without the logs and records I cannot verify the chronology or challenge whether the processing was lawful.
The information gap creates an evidentiary imbalance and prevents an effective remedy.
The branch manager reviewed the customer file and decided that selected disclosure was sufficient.
Formal access rights are ineffective if the evidence needed to exercise those rights remains controlled by the bank.
The river bank near the branch flooded during winter and delayed access to the office archive.
